title: Grilled hake with sweet potato and green beans
summary: Light, lean and full of flavour.
steps: Scrub the sweet potato and prick it with a fork. Bake it at 200 °C for 35 to 40 minutes, or microwave it on high for 6 to 8 minutes, until soft right through.
Pat the hake dry and brush it with the olive oil, crushed garlic, lemon juice, salt and pepper.
Grill it for about 4 minutes a side, until it is white all the way through and flakes easily.
Meanwhile trim the green beans and steam or boil them for 4 to 5 minutes, until bright green and just tender.
Split the sweet potato and serve it with the fish and beans and a lemon wedge.
